verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a documented API-key mechanism letting external code call 'the same endpoints the web UI uses' and a gateway API exposing workspaces as OpenAI-compatible endpoints, plus a CLI reference, indicating a genuine programmatic surface. However, a live probe for a public OpenAPI/swagger spec on the docs site returned 404 for all candidate paths, so there's no discoverable formal API reference confirming full endpoint coverage. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/swagger spec or complete endpoint reference, and independent developer corroboration of using the API end-to-end.
